summary: Implementation plan for fixing Quotation Studio and Document preview workflows: (1) Non-expanding free-floating stamp/signature overlay bounds, (2) Context-aware Page Break & Vertical Spacer insertion (above inspected block in Right Inspector, below last block in Left Drawer, plus last-row line item page break support), (3) Header Logo-Only vertical field stacking, widened Right Inspector zone alignment cards, and inline contact icon wrapping, (4) Direct Save Changes persistence in Settings Preview & Studio Sandbox, and (5) Granular sub-element click selection on A4 preview with Right Inspector auto-scroll focus.
